NONE: › to praise someone or something in a speech or piece of writing

example: Critics everywhere have eulogized her new novel.
各地的評論家都對她的新小說大加稱讚。
They eulogized over the breathtaking views.
他們對這令人心醉神迷的美景讚不絕口。

NONE: › a speech, piece of writing, poem, etc. containing great praise, especially for someone who recently died or retired from work
悼詞，悼文；（爲剛剛退休的人所作的）頌詞，頌文

example: He was the most self-effacing of men - the last thing he would have relished was a eulogy.
他爲人極其謙遜，最不喜聽頌辭。
The song was a eulogy to the joys of travelling.
這是一首讚頌旅行樂趣的歌曲。
